title: Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo: Hoshimitou Kanashimi no Fukushuuki
native_title: 金田一少年の事件簿 ～星見島 悲しみの復讐鬼～
overview:
Only you, the culprit, know the truth of the case!?

This is not a game that encourages crime, but a game in which you enjoy deductive tricks set in the world of "Kindaichi Shounen no Jikenbo."

Based on the Kindaichi Case Files anime, this adventure turns the usual mystery around: instead of playing the young detective Hajime Kindaichi, you play the culprit. On Hoshimi Island, plan and carry out the perfect crime, choosing your words and actions carefully and slipping past the others unseen. Kindaichi, Miyuki Nanase, Inspector Kenmochi and Superintendent Akechi are all on the case - if Kindaichi sees through your scheme, it ends badly for you.

- Culprits from the series appear to offer advice
- 1 player, memory backup support

事件の真相は犯人であるキミしか知らない！？

この作品は、犯罪を助長するゲームではなく、『金田一少年の事件簿』の世界を舞台に推理トリックを楽しむゲームです
